p.s: The best way of travel is in a group led by a tour guide.
Some poeple think like that, and other onces think that is better travel with a group of poeple but without a tour guide.
I am agree with the first statement by some reasons.
First, you may have a good schedule of fun activities.

If you like to travel and if you are an organized person, you will like to have an schedule with all your activities, and also someone who show you the bests parts of the city, explain their history, the good and bad things, the meaning of the place, etc.
By following a schedule you may have all your time planned, and you can have the opportunity of visit a lot of parts.
In a second point, traveling in a group is very fun.

If you do not know any poeple, is a good opportunity to meet some friends, share experiences, know poeple of different parts of the world, understand different cultures and also you can practice a foreign language.
Finally, and no less important, you can save a lot of money by traveling in a group led by a tour guide.
All poeple know that travel on this times is very expensive, and if you travel in group, you will have some very good advantages like saving money in the hotel, or in your transportation.
So if you save money, you have the possibility of travel two or three times in a year, and that is really fantastic.
Like a conslusion, I can say that all poeple or the most of the poeple love to travel around the world.
Is very excited to think on having the opportunity of visit a lot of cities, meeting poeple of different cultures, even learn about history, and of course saving money.
That is why I think that the best way of travel is in group led by a tour guide.
